paper.title: OA-WAM: Object-Addressable World Action Model for Robust Robot Manipulation
paper.summary: OA-WAM separates stable object identity from time-varying content and constrains slot keys to route through the identity subspace.

evidence.label: Problem and object-addressability claim
evidence.excerpt: The manuscript frames the failure as missing object addressability and separates object identity from current content.

evidence.label: Slot construction and lifecycle
evidence.excerpt: A 320-dimensional slot concatenates addr (32), cnt (256), frame (16), and role (16); addr is fixed per episode while cnt is refreshed per frame.

evidence.label: Action query readout
evidence.excerpt: The action head reads the final hidden state at the ACT_Q token.

evidence.label: Slot-aware Q/K/V rule
evidence.excerpt: Only slot K applies mask<=32 before projection; Q and V use the full hidden state, and non-slot positions keep base attention.

evidence.label: Per-layer reset and boundary
evidence.excerpt: After every block the first 32 slot coordinates are restored from addr, while the other 4064 coordinates remain updated; the guarantee assumes correct slot extraction.

evidence.label: OA isolation ablation
evidence.excerpt: LP-camera success is 60.5 without OA, 67.2 with reset only, and 80.5 with mask and reset.

evidence.label: Address-swap intervention
evidence.excerpt: Swapping the target address while holding other inputs fixed yields swap-binding 0.87 for full OA-WAM, versus 0.19 without the key mask and at most 0.09 for holistic baselines.

evidence.label: Sensor-noise boundary
evidence.excerpt: Sensor-noise success is 75.6 for OA-WAM, 89.7 for pi-0.5, and 92.7 for Cosmos-Policy; the manuscript attributes the deficit to slot extraction.

claims.title: Stable address-based slot routing
claims.summary: Slot candidates expose stable identity through K while Q, V, and residual state retain current context and content.

claims.title: The action head is not address-only
claims.summary: The action head reads the final ACT_Q hidden state rather than a raw address vector.

claims.title: Routing is conditional on slot extraction
claims.summary: The architectural constraint cannot recover an object missed by upstream perception or an ambiguously initialized address.

contributions.title: Address-only slot keys with per-layer address reset
contributions.summary: A parameter-free mask and reset keep slot routing tied to episode-stable identity.

contributions.title: Object addressability problem framing
contributions.summary: The paper separates which object to act on from what that object currently is.

concepts.title: Stable address
concepts.summary: The first 32 slot coordinates identify an object and remain fixed during an episode.

concepts.title: Time-varying content
concepts.summary: A 256-dimensional content vector is recomputed from the current observation each frame.

concepts.title: Selection versus payload
concepts.summary: QK determines reading weights and V carries the information that is mixed.

modules.title: Object slot
modules.summary: The pre-adapter slot concatenates addr, cnt, frame, and role.

modules.title: Slot-aware transformer attention
modules.summary: The mask changes slot K inputs and the reset restores address coordinates after each block.

modules.title: Action head
modules.summary: The action head consumes the final ACT_Q hidden state.

relations.title: Address supplies slot key input
relations.summary: The slot key projection receives only the first 32 coordinates.

relations.title: Content remains available to values
relations.summary: The value projection receives the full hidden state.

relations.title: ACT_Q supplies the action head
relations.summary: The action head reads H_ACT_Q after the trunk.

equations.title: Slot-aware Q/K/V
equations.text: K=W_K mask<=32(x); Q=W_Q x; V=W_V x

algorithms.title: Per-layer address reset
algorithms.summary: After every block, restore slot coordinates 1:32 from the cached address.

experiments.title: Key-mask and reset isolation
experiments.summary: V2, V1, and V0 compare common training and evaluation with the two OA switches changed.

experiments.title: Address-swap intervention
experiments.summary: The target address is swapped while other inputs remain fixed, then trajectory alignment is measured.

experiments.title: Sensor-noise boundary
experiments.summary: The weaker sensor-noise result exposes the dependence on upstream slot extraction.
